name: io.github.ciinkwia/twitter-signal-mcp
description: Live X/Twitter search, profiles, leads, pain points, bot checks, AI digests. Paid per call, x402.

environmentVariables.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Coinbase CDP API key ID for the wallet that pays the per-call USDC fee

environmentVariables.name: X402_MAX_PRICE
environmentVariables.description: Hard per-call USD ceiling; requests quoting more are refused before signing (default 0.05)

environmentVariables.name: CDP_ACCOUNT_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Named CDP account to pay from (created automatically; default twitter-signal-mcp)
